claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:50 p.m. PDT (SLC-4E).
The mission followed a Sunday delay.
The mission featured a first-stage booster landing on the droneship "Of Course I Still Love You" in the Pacific Ocean.
The launch location was Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E).
The booster landed on the "Of Course I Still Love You" droneship.
The launch was visible from parts of California.
The booster landing occurred about 8.5 minutes after liftoff.
